name: Tomitsuka Ryou
source:
"Don't be shy. It's part of my job." 

A maintenance worker who appears to have free reign of the academy.

He's rarely seen by the students, which has given rise to an urban legend: Those who find him will be blessed with good fortune. 

He also goes in and out of the research district and has ties to a certain secret organizaiton.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
